name: A Recipe Out of Time
description:
Tamsin recognizes a brewing notation thought lost generations ago.

Obtain a Witch Pupil from witches and use the installed Witch Eye recipe in JEI. Earn End Remastered's witch eye advancement by obtaining the eye. This record keeps working after you use the eye. Eyes are never consumed by this quest. Loot can be random; choose other routes for the portal if a source proves elusive.
